description: Rotate a Tail 2's barrel 90° for portrait framing (enable) or back to landscape (disable) — a motorized physical rotation no Tiny 2 has. Takes ~1.5s; the tool polls the status push for the new orientation and returns settled:false if the motor hadn't finished within ~5s. MEASURED 2026-09-26: while the motor is in motion the camera can acknowledge a write and silently drop it — if settled stays false, retry the command. Hardware-verified both directions.
name: obsbot_tail2_portrait
